audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Jerusalem destroyed, bodies, blood, grief, nations, vengeance, and communal survival.

verses.restored: O GOD, the nations are come into thine inheritance; thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem on heaps.

familiar.text: O GOD, the heathen are come into thine inheritance; thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem on heaps.

notes.title: Destroyed Jerusalem
notes.body: This communal lament speaks from catastrophe, desecration, killing, and grief. Such trauma must not be converted into permission for revenge or collective punishment.

modern.text: The nations, O God, have invaded Your inheritance; they have defiled Your holy temple and reduced Jerusalem to rubble.

original.text: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ף אֱֽלֹהִ֡ים בָּ֤אוּ גוֹיִ֨ם בְּֽנַחֲלָתֶ֗ךָ טִ֭מְּאוּ אֶת הֵיכַ֣ל קָדְשֶׁ֑ךָ שָׂ֖מוּ אֶת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֣ם לְעִיִּֽים

verses.restored: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be meat to the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of thy saints to the beasts of the earth.

familiar.text: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be meat unto the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.

modern.text: They have given the corpses of Your servants as food to the birds of the air, the flesh of Your saints to the beasts of the earth.

original.text: נָֽתְנ֡וּ אֶת נִבְלַ֬ת עֲבָדֶ֗יךָ מַ֭אֲכָל לְע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם בְּשַׂ֥ר חֲ֝סִידֶ֗יךָ לְחַיְתוֹ אָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; and there was none to bury them.

familiar.text: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; and there was none to bury them.

modern.text: They have poured out their blood like water all around Jerusalem, and there is no one to bury the dead.

original.text: שָׁפְכ֬וּ דָמָ֨ם כַּמַּ֗יִם סְֽבִ֘יב֤וֹת יְֽרוּשָׁלִָ֗ם וְאֵ֣ין קוֹבֵֽר

verses.restored: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.

familiar.text: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.

modern.text: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scorn and derision to those around us.

original.text: הָיִ֣ינוּ חֶ֭רְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנֵ֑ינוּ לַ֥עַג וָ֝קֶ֗לֶס לִסְבִיבוֹתֵֽינוּ

verses.restored: How long, YHWH? wilt thou be angry for ever? shall thy jealousy burn like fire?

familiar.text: How long, LORD? wilt thou be angry for ever? shall thy jealousy burn like fire?

modern.text: How long, O LORD? Will You be angry forever? Will Your jealousy burn like fire?

original.text: עַד מָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תֶּאֱנַ֣ף לָנֶ֑צַח תִּבְעַ֥ר כְּמוֹ אֵ֝֗שׁ קִנְאָתֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Pour out thy wrath upon the nations that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.

familiar.text: Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.

modern.text: Pour out Your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge You, on the kingdoms that refuse to call on Your name,

original.text: שְׁפֹ֤ךְ חֲמָתְךָ֨ אֶֽל הַגּוֹיִם֮ אֲשֶׁ֪ר לֹא יְדָ֫ע֥וּךָ וְעַ֥ל מַמְלָכ֑וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ֝שִׁמְךָ֗ לֹ֣א קָרָֽאוּ

verses.restored: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his dwelling place.

familiar.text: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his dwelling place.

modern.text: for they have devoured Jacob and devastated his homeland.

original.text: כִּ֭י אָכַ֣ל אֶֽת יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְֽאֶת נָוֵ֥הוּ הֵשַֽׁמּוּ

verses.restored: O remember not against us former iniquities: let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low.

familiar.text: O remember not against us former iniquities: let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low.

modern.text: Do not hold past sins against us; let Your compassion come quickly, for we are brought low.

original.text: אַֽל תִּזְכָּר לָנוּ֮ עֲוֺנֹ֪ת רִאשֹׁ֫נִ֥ים מַ֭הֵר יְקַדְּמ֣וּנוּ רַחֲמֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י דַלּ֣וֹנוּ מְאֹֽד

verses.restored: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name: and deliver us, and purge away our sins, for thy name’s sake.

familiar.text: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name: and deliver us, and purge away our sins, for thy name’s sake.

modern.text: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of Your name; deliver us and atone for our sins, for the sake of Your name.

original.text: עָזְרֵ֤נוּ אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י יִשְׁעֵ֗נוּ עַל דְּבַ֥ר כְּבֽוֹד שְׁמֶ֑ךָ וְהַצִּילֵ֥נוּ וְכַפֵּ֥ר עַל חַ֝טֹּאתֵ֗ינוּ לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Wherefore should the nations say, Where is their God? let him be known among the nations in our sight by the revenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed.

familiar.text: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is their God? let him be known among the heathen in our sight by the revenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed.

modern.text: Why should the nations ask, “Where is their God?” Before our eyes, make known among the nations Your vengeance for the bloodshed of Your servants.

original.text: לָ֤מָּה יֹאמְר֣וּ הַגּוֹיִם֮ אַיֵּ֪ה אֱֽלֹהֵ֫יהֶ֥ם יִוָּדַ֣ע בגיים לְעֵינֵ֑ינוּ נִ֝קְמַ֗ת דַּֽם עֲבָדֶ֥יךָ הַשָּׁפֽוּךְ

verses.restored: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die;

familiar.text: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die;

modern.text: May the groans of the captives reach You; by the strength of Your arm preserve those condemned to death.

original.text: תָּ֤ב֣וֹא לְפָנֶיךָ֮ אֶנְקַ֪ת אָ֫סִ֥יר כְּגֹ֥דֶל זְרוֹעֲךָ֑ ה֝וֹתֵ֗ר בְּנֵ֣י תְמוּתָֽה

verses.restored: And render to our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.

familiar.text: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.

modern.text: Pay back into the laps of our neighbors sevenfold the reproach they hurled at You, O Lord.

original.text: וְהָ֘שֵׁ֤ב לִשְׁכֵנֵ֣ינוּ שִׁ֭בְעָתַיִם אֶל חֵיקָ֑ם חֶרְפָּ֘תָ֤ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר חֵרְפ֣וּךָ אֲדֹנָֽי

verses.restored: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will show forth thy praise to all generations.

familiar.text: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations.

modern.text: Then we Your people, the sheep of Your pasture, will thank You forever; from generation to generation we will declare Your praise.

original.text: וַאֲנַ֤חְנוּ עַמְּךָ֨ וְצֹ֥אן מַרְעִיתֶךָ֮ נ֤וֹדֶ֥ה לְּךָ֗ לְע֫וֹלָ֥ם לְדֹ֥ר וָדֹ֑ר נְ֝סַפֵּ֗ר תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: This atrocity lament must never authorize revenge, genocide, collective punishment, or modern enemy-mapping.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit. Preserve poetic parallelism, superscriptions, duplicate/parallel psalms, and significant Hebrew/Greek divergences rather than harmonizing them.
